q1_issues.issue: 'maintain' takes Patient, but maintaining need not create/destroy/consume or physically change the exterior, and the instruction set says to default to Theme when the change test is unclear.

q2_gaps: bare frequency adverb ('regularly', 'often', 'occasionally') — Frequency & habitual schedules offers only (Every e <n> <unit>) and (TimesPer e <n> <unit>), both of which need a number and a unit, so an unquantified frequency adverb has no licensed form and lands in Manner by default
notes: Imperative handling is correct: one Directive seal per coordinated VP with the shared object symbol reused, manner inside the seal, no tense/occurrence, no addressee minted, and the definite referents' typing (Member exterior, GroupOf cabinets) plus their presupposed PartOf link projected outside the seals. 'clean' is explicitly a Patient verb; only 'maintain' is questionable.
